weakness: Corporate-to-OT firewall allows broad rules; MES dual-homed; internal interface not monitored; refrigeration modem bypasses managed interfaces
source: P07 assessment (SC-07 objectives); P01 R-001; P03 CSF PR.IR-01
remediation_plan: Build an OT DMZ for MES, historian replica, and remote access; rebuild rules to named flows; remove dual-homing; move the cold-chain gateway to its own segment
milestones: 2026-10-31 design approved; 2026-12-31 MES moved to OT DMZ; 2027-03-31 rule rebuild complete

weakness: OT remote access always on, shared, without MFA or approval
remediation_plan: Disable the integrator VPN and modem except during supervised sessions now; deploy an OT remote access gateway with named accounts, MFA, per-session approval, and recording

weakness: Shared accounts on HMIs, SCADA, the recipe system, and the records application administrator
remediation_plan: Named accounts with badge or PIN sign-in on HMIs; named recipe and engineering accounts; separate records administrator
milestones: 2026-11-15 records application; 2026-12-31 HMIs and recipe system

weakness: OT account types undocumented; shared accounts not managed at termination; no account reviews
remediation_plan: Document account types; add Controls Engineer to termination notices; rotate shared passwords at each production termination until POAM-003 closes; quarterly reviews

weakness: Default administrator password on refrigeration controller; weak, never-changed shared OT passwords
remediation_plan: Change the default password; restrict the interface to the OT engineering subnet; password standard for OT devices
milestones: 2026-09-30 default changed; 2026-11-30 standard applied to all OT devices

weakness: OT backups not immutable, co-located, and domain-joined; PLC programs not backed up; cloud backups share the production account
remediation_plan: Offline and immutable copies of SCADA and MES backups; PLC program repository with versioning; cloud backups to a separate account

weakness: No restore or contingency test ever performed
remediation_plan: Quarterly restore tests in the sanitation window, including verification of restored formulations against the signed master
milestones: 2026-11-14 first SCADA and MES restore test; 2027-02-13 second

weakness: No contingency plan for the PPCM
remediation_plan: Contingency plan from the BIA with manual CCP monitoring, product hold, and recovery priorities

weakness: No OT change control; changes made without FSQA approval or food defense reanalysis
remediation_plan: OT change procedure: request, test, FSQA sign-off for CCP and actionable-step changes, food defense check, record
milestones: 2026-10-31 procedure approved; 2026-12-31 first quarterly audit of changes

weakness: No integrity verification of formulations, setpoints, or PLC programs
remediation_plan: Hash-verified recipe releases; weekly PLC program checksum comparison; alerts on cure and CIP setpoint changes to FSQA
milestones: 2026-12-31 recipe hashing and alerts; 2027-01-31 PLC checksums

weakness: CCP and food defense records editable without an audit trail
remediation_plan: Enable historian audit trail; record locking after sign-off; separate administrator; document integrity controls for FSIS and FDA review
milestones: 2026-11-15 audit trail on; 2026-12-31 integrity controls documented

weakness: No log review in IT or OT
remediation_plan: Central log workspace with 1-year retention; weekly IT review; daily FSQA review of recipe and setpoint alerts

weakness: No monitoring of the control network or OT hosts
source: P07; P01 R-001; P03 CSF DE.CM-09
remediation_plan: OT monitoring service with passive network detection and alerts on setpoint, recipe, and PLC program changes

weakness: No malware protection on OT hosts or at OT entry points
remediation_plan: Application allowlisting on HMIs and OT servers; media scanning kiosk; USB blocking
resources_required: Included in POAM-013; $8K kiosk and workstation

weakness: No OT asset inventory
remediation_plan: OT inventory with firmware versions, network addresses, owners, and support status
resources_required: Staff time; passive discovery through POAM-013

weakness: Excess OT and records administrator privileges
remediation_plan: Least-privilege roles for integrator, engineering, and records administration

weakness: No OT incident handling or food safety decision path
remediation_plan: Adopt POL-03 and the P08 runbook; forensic retainer with OT capability; tabletop with FSQA

weakness: Floor staff have no reporting requirement or channel
remediation_plan: Reporting line on every HMI and in the break rooms; include in floor training

weakness: No awareness training for production, sanitation, maintenance, or temporary staff
remediation_plan: Floor-level security and food defense awareness at hire and annually (bilingual); quarterly phishing exercises for office staff
milestones: 2026-10-31 food defense awareness for seafood room; 2026-11-30 all floor staff

weakness: No security requirements or monitoring for external service providers
remediation_plan: Vendor tiering; security terms for OT vendors; annual SOC 2 review (P09)
milestones: 2026-08-21 cold-chain vendor SOC 2 reviewed (P09); 2027-01-31 contract terms for all critical vendors

weakness: Engine room keys not changed after a 2025 departure
remediation_plan: Rekey the engine room; key log
